pickupDelivery.title: Pickup & delivery
pickupDelivery.body: Manage pickup and delivery orders in one dashboard: time slots, status and kitchen screen, with no commission per order.

groupOrders.title: Group orders
groupOrders.body: Companies, schools or clubs order separately on one link. You keep overview; everyone pays as agreed.

qrOrder.title: Order via QR code
qrOrder.body: QR at the table or in the queue: guests scan, order and pay themselves. More time for service in your venue.

loyalty.title: Loyalty card
loyalty.body: Stamps and rewards are built into the platform — no separate loyalty subscription. Easy for you, great for regulars.

features.title: You do what you love: delight people with great food — we handle the rest.

webshop.title: Webshop & pickup
webshop.body: Customers order online for pickup or delivery — menu, time slots and payment in one flow.

adminKitchen.title: Admin & kitchen
adminKitchen.body: Orders arrive on the kitchen screen and in your admin; statuses sync with the POS.

ownWebsite.title: Your own website
ownWebsite.body: Free website in your branding, colours and custom domain. Already have a site? Add the order button to your website.

noCommission.title: No commission
noCommission.body: Fixed monthly fee. No percentage on revenue through the ordering platform.

multilingual.title: Multilingual
multilingual.body: Guests order in 9 languages — menu and checkout automatically in your customer's language, without separate translations.

posLink.title: POS integration
posLink.body: Connect the online ordering platform to your POS: online orders, tickets and status in one flow, independent of your current POS vendor.

mission.title: What's included

needPos.q: Do I need a full POS system?
needPos.a: No. Vysion Order works standalone. Want POS and kitchen too? That is possible within the same Vysion account.

cost.a: €49 per month excl. VAT. No commission on orders. Cancel monthly.

login.q: Where do I log in after registration?
login.a: Via Log in on {officialHost}; you are redirected to the platform with your tenant.

website.q: Can I link my existing website?
website.a: Yes. Link a button on your site to your personal shop URL (tenant.ordervysion.com). No iframe required.

multiTenant.q: Does this work for multiple venues?
multiTenant.a: Each venue has its own tenant; the platform is multi-tenant and suitable for many locations.

installCost.q: Do I have to pay setup fees?
installCost.a: No. You register online and start your trial.

contract.q: Do I need an annual contract?
contract.a: No. Pay monthly and cancel anytime.

start.a: Register via Start free; you go to {registerHost} with the online ordering product line.
